name: cue-plugin-registry
docs: Backed by assistant/src/plugins/registry/ (types/registry-file/indexer/search/embedding-seed). This file is the curated, commit-pinned, security-reviewed allowlist that backs `cue plugins search/reindex/versions/publish`. It scales like the skills marketplace: `sources` are the GitHub repos/orgs the indexer crawls for plugin manifests (package.json declaring an @vellumai/plugin-api peerDependency); `plugins` are the reviewed, pinned entries surfaced by default. Community repos are added post-alpha via PR (see `cue plugins publish`).

reviewStatuses.curated: First-party or hand-reviewed by the Cue team; pinned to a specific commit; surfaced by default.
reviewStatuses.community: Submitted via PR, license + manifest verified, pinned to a commit; surfaced with a third-party notice.
reviewStatuses.unreviewed: Indexed from an allowlisted source but not yet hand-reviewed; only shown when --allow-unreviewed is passed.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that strips filler words to cut token usage.

plugins.name: simple-memory
plugins.description: Reference memory plugin that exercises the full plugin API with low-cost variants of the memory defaults. Useful as a template when authoring a plugin.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Route each turn to a model chosen by intent — cheap models for simple asks, stronger models for hard reasoning — via a pre-model-call hook.

plugins.name: admin-copilot
